comment: ONE keyword canon for page classification. Replaces page_canon.json (retired) and leaf_keywords.json. Keyed by taxonomy node; a leaf takes its own lists and its ancestors' (ancestor words count half). Deciding = page titles only. Codability comes from page_taxonomy.json only. specialty_titles maps title phrases to a specialty (used by the specialty step, not by the keyword rule). cleanup_log lists every word removed or moved by clean_keyword_canon.py.
matching: Match case-insensitively on whole words or whole phrases, never on substrings of a longer word.
Longest match wins: when one term is contained in a longer term that also matched at the same place, count only the longer one.
title_terms are names a document prints as its title or main heading. They count more when found in the title zone (the first lines of the page).
A single-word title term counts as a title hit only when it is a heading on its own line, not when it appears inside a sentence.
body_terms are supporting words found in the body of that kind of page.

ambiguous_terms are short abbreviations, generic words, or terms shared by more than one page type. They add to a score only when another term of the same sub-type has already matched; they never decide a page alone.

Score each sub-type, take the best sub-type per page type as that page type's score, and report the top page type, its best sub-type, the score, the margin over the second page type, and whether a title term hit in the title zone.

agreement.note: 2026-11-24 (user): page type / codability confidence by how the model and the keywords agree on the chosen type (page_classify/agreement.py): A both #1 -> model p; B model #1, keywords 2-3 -> p x b_factor; C model #1 only -> p x c_factor, at most c_cap; D model 2-3 or same L1 -> d_value; E another L1 -> e_value. Codability: the model p over every type with that codability, x c_factor (cap c_cap) when one first differs, e_value when both do.

priority.comment: Checked after the gates and before rank points, in this order: (0) progress_note_model_guard, (1..4) rules in order. Family priority (2026-11-22, user): checked after the gates and before rank points. The first rule that fires restricts the winner to its family (the leaves under that L1), unless the page-leaf model is more than settings.model_sure_other_l1 sure of a family listed in that rule's 'yields_to'. A header counts when a line starts with it followed by ':' or nothing else, or when the OCR detected it as a heading; lines of at most max_header_words words. Titles count only in the title zone (first title_zone_lines lines). The winning leaf inside the family is still chosen by rank points; for Progress Note the subtype then follows the section rules (Page Classification 101, suggestion 2). Each page records priority_rule.

progress_note_model_guard.comment: A Progress Note page often carries words of other families (an embedded lab table, a medication list, an order). When the page-leaf model says Progress Note, keep it. Checked first, before the Deciding step and before the priority rules.
progress_note_model_guard.fires_when: the page-leaf model's Progress Note probability (sum over its Progress Note leaves) is at least min_model_prob
progress_note_model_guard.effect: the winner is restricted to Progress Note leaves; other families' Deciding words and keywords cannot move the page
progress_note_model_guard.yields_to: priority rules discharge_summary, operative_note and procedure_note, but only when they fire on a TITLE in the title zone (not on headers alone)

rules.name: progress_note_headers
rules.comment: Fires on a visit header, on one strong header, or on headers from at least min_groups different note groups. Beats Lab Report, Medication Record, Problem List, Clinical Summary, Forms and Questionnaires, Demographics, Order and Requisition, Immunization, Patient Communication and Administrative. Does not fire on a letter (opens 'Dear', closes 'Sincerely').
rules.groups_need_one_of_comment: 2026-11-22 (tuned on val): a diagnostic report heads Exam + Impression (objective + assessment); a note also heads a subjective or plan section. On val this kept 7 lab / radiology pages out of Progress Note and lost 1 note page.
